correctness.rationale: The signed-short-arc cap equals the exact double tangent-determinant integral. Expanding sin of the curvature turn gives A(s,h)=k h^3/12+(k_ss/480-k^3/240)h^5+O_K(h^7); independent symbolic integration verified both h^5 coefficients. Uniform positivity of curvature guarantees one inverse H(s,t), and the endpoint midpoint coordinate map has Jacobian one, so Pr(M<=t)=2/P^2 int H ds. Inversion and integration by parts yield 2(12t)^(1/3)/P^2 int k^(-1/3) ds + 2t/(5P^2)(2pi-int k_s^2/k^3 ds)+O(t^(5/3)). Jensen and the radius-of-curvature harmonic family yield the circle extremals, J=2pi m^2((1-eps^2)^(-1/2)-1), and eps_m=sqrt(2m^2+1)/(m^2+1). For each arc midpoint, |h|/H is exactly uniform; V^3 maps to z^(-2/3)/3 and the joint total variation limit follows by density convergence and Scheffe; q(s) proportional k^(-1/3) reconstructs k using int k ds=2pi. Remainder fixed curve, not uniform in harmonic frequency.
